scope: Cloud-only original bounded CPU numerical/semantic fixtures

outcomes.name: finite_centered_vocabulary_tile_merge
outcomes.decision: Centered merge is CPU-supported for finite rounded logits, with explicit empty-tile handling and global-index ties; no bitwise/GPU/performance claim.

outcomes.name: padding_empty_tile_and_global_argmax
outcomes.decision: Reject unguarded empty-tile moment merges and traversal-order tie selection.

outcomes.name: ignored_nonfinite_logits_and_nll_boundary
outcomes.decision: Unconditional scatter-zero changes baseline nonfinite propagation. Preserve finite-path opportunity but guard all actual rounded logits or use an exact reference fallback.

outcomes.name: nonfinite_incoming_gradient_and_denominator
outcomes.decision: Compaction with reference autograd preserves this finite-logit fixture; naive softmax-minus-onehot loses target-NaN parity for infinite effective upstream gradients. Guard or preserve reference operation order.

outcomes.name: nonfinite_effective_head_weights
outcomes.decision: Zero dlogits @ nonfinite W is not zero. Validate effective FP16 head weights, not only FP32 source weights, before zero-row elision.

outcomes.name: finite_operands_fp16_logit_overflow
outcomes.decision: Finite inputs/weights alone do not guard FP16 GEMM-output overflow. Check actual rounded logits already produced by metric forward, otherwise exact fallback.
